title: Magnific
note: It used to be called Freepik. A powerful place for image assets (and video/audio now). I search for mockups here and create product visuals.

title: Musopen
note: All the music here is royalty-free and copyright-free — meaning you can use it in your YouTube video or short film.

title: Poki
note: A collection of games that you can play online instantly! Some games I like: Stickman Hook, Ledge Throw, and Subway Surfers.

title: Google Doodle Games
note: Find and play all the archived Google Doodle games here! My favorites are PAC-MAN, Halloween 2022, and Halloween 2020.

title: Claude Academy
note: Learn how to work with AI from Claude's official courses (certificate granted).

title: iLoveIMG
note: Edit your image for free on the web.

title: iLovePDF
note: A powerful tool for PDF-related work. Free.

title: Live Performances / Experience / Films in LA
note: A running list of places in LA to check when I'm free and looking for something fun.

title: Themed Entertainment Jobs
note: A job board dedicated to positions in the themed entertainment industry.

title: ASCII Art Generator
note: Fun stuff when people actually write HTML line by line — mine is on my contact page.

title: Khan Academy
note: For anyone who wants to build a specific hard skill or work through a full course. In high school I found their AP courses direct and easy to follow — great as self-study material or a supplement to class. Right now I'm using it to learn computer programming.

title: Crash Course
note: Anything you want to learn, they have a dedicated, well-organized, and visually engaging course for it. Fun fact: co-founder John Green is also the writer of *The Fault in Our Stars*.

title: Chuck Lorre's Vanity Cards
note: The full archive of Vanity Cards from the creator of my favorite sitcom, *The Big Bang Theory* (of course, he's more than that — he's the king of the sitcom). He's still updating this website!!
